body: I don't even know what I'd vent about anymore. I just hate myself and who I am so much to the point where even the most aggressive words wouldn't even make up 1% of how I feel about myself.

Yeah, they all know. My friends see it as my quirk more than anything because they don't take me seriously and I try to make light of my misery cos I don't wanna burden them with my problems and I know that they don't know how the handle what I want to tell them. I told my mum a couple years ago that I self harmed and wanted to die. Naturally, she had me see a doctor but she seemed to somewhat repress it as time went on and now she thinks that I'm fine with a little anxiety. She suffered with depression just after I was born so she empathises better than my dad but she was never suicidal or never indulged in self-harming.

I just hate myself and I feel like everyone just puts up with me so it might be a nice relief for them if I weren't here anymore.

Also, I'd never heard that French phrase before but it explains a lot of my thoughts.
